Source: https://github.com/t4ce/Lumen.git
Pinned commit: f0a9fa408de39594b99d864deab50d027e105f07

This directory is a source-vendored snapshot of the Lumen commit previously
recorded by TRUEOS as vendor/lumen. It is stored as ordinary files so an
offline TRUEOS checkout retains the framework sources without needing to
initialize another submodule.

TRUEOS enables Lumen with default features disabled and `truega` enabled.
That feature is mutually exclusive with `host-runtime` and compiles only the
typed asynchronous backend and `AsyncModule` contracts: no synchronous
`Module`, CPU tensor, CUDA, host threading, or blocking compatibility surface
is present in the kernel build. TRUEOS implements the fixed-shape device
tensor and operation in src/lumen/mod.rs and retains scheduling, MSI
completion, model I/O, and FPGA ABI ownership.
